graphics.geometry: Darkened eastern-hemisphere Blue Marble. Cairo pin on the Nile delta. London, Mumbai and Sydney are margin pins: those cities are off this plate. Green and crimson curtains are a schematic, not a measurement.
graphics.clear: One label at a time. Pins stay after they light. Curtains keep moving.

words_note: Labels follow the locked words: green and crimson, funnel down, the middle, then London, Cairo, Mumbai and Sydney. Cairo is the only pin on this eastern-hemisphere plate.
